item: Julia receives a [JGI grant](https://jgi.doe.gov/user-science/science-stories/jgi-announces-2026-new-investigator-portfolio) to sequence and assemble radish genomes!
Elli begins her postdoc with the Gaut Lab at UC Irvine!
Alyssa accepts a job as research conservation geneticist with the Atlanta Botanical Gardens!

Preprint alert! Collaboration on the math behind a long-standing idea based on empirical work from former lab postdocs Wenbin Mei, Sion Renny-Byfield, and Edwin Solares. [preprint](https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.64898/2026.02.26.708357v1)
Lab attends the Maize Meeting in Cologne
Regina is awarded a Chicago Fellows Postdoctoral Fellowship to work with Dr. Julia Kreiner at U. Chicago!

Natasha Dhamrait wins a [Bilinski Fellowship](https://marinescience.ucdavis.edu/news/announcing-uc-davis-bilinski-fellows-bodega-marine-laboratory-2026-27) for science-art data visualization. Former lab undergrad Julianna Porter another winner!

Preprint alert! New work on single cell RNA-seq and QTL mapping to learn about the genetics of maize domestication. Collaboration with former lab postdoc Ning Yang. [preprint](https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.64898/2026.08.10.743805v2)
Regina Fairbanks graduates! Heading off to a postdoc with [Julia Kreiner](https://kreinerlab.com)

[Murillo Rodrigues](https://www.m-rodrigues.me) joins the lab to work on ARGs in plants as part of a [Simons Foundation Postdoctoral Fellowship](https://www.simonsfoundation.org/grant/simons-postdoctoral-fellowships-in-plant-biology/)
